scope: All 5445 development pairs; remove pairs h,h+8, keeping all MLPs, embeddings and residual paths.
order: Same one-pass order as the completed strict-fidelity experiment: increasing mean absolute summed marginal activation-replacement effects.
acceptance: At most five additional incorrect pairs relative to native 5436/5445, and at least .99 pair accuracy in every development pair population. Prediction identity is measured but is not a selection criterion.
replay: Freeze mask before loading the same 1978 exposed assessment pairs. Report correctness and prediction agreement without revising the mask.
role: Separate exploratory task-preserving simplification after the strict choice-fidelity pass accepted no deletions. It does not satisfy the prior fidelity criterion or establish independent qualification.
